primary_endpoint: Pharmacokinetic measures (Cmax, Tmax, AUC0–24, terminal half-life, and trough concentrations) of elafibranor and active metabolite GFT1007 at specified study timepoints.
efficacy_outcome: PK values were reported for both dose groups; for example, elafibranor Cmax was 385.216 ng/mL with 80 mg and 658.054 ng/mL with 120 mg. No MASH efficacy outcome was reported.
safety_signal: No serious adverse events or deaths: 0/5 participants in each dose group.
